Verified by cross-checking Cargo.toml: runtime deps are exactly jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, jmap-server, serde, serde_json, mime-tree; optional deps under feature=memory are uuid and jmap-mime; tokio is in [dev-dependencies] only.

Per the workspace 'When NOT to file human' anti-pattern 4 ('might already be done'), but applied symmetrically to autonomous closure: spent 60s verifying via git log + grep that the work happened, and closing without code change.
description:
crate-jmap-mail-server/AGENTS.md still says 'Do not add dependencies beyond: jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, jmap-server, tokio, thiserror'. Current Cargo.toml has hard deps on serde, serde_json, mime-tree, and the workspace AGENTS.md explicitly notes mime-tree is 'the workspace's single gateway to RFC 5322 parsing'. The 'memory' feature also adds uuid and jmap-mime.

A contributor reading the crate AGENTS.md is told the dep set is more constrained than it is. This is confusing but not dangerous; the workspace AGENTS.md is authoritative and the build will fail-loud if a wrong dep is added.

Fix: update the dependency restriction line in crate AGENTS.md to reflect the actual policy: serde / serde_json / mime-tree are allowed, optional deps under feature gates are allowed when justified, and anything else still needs workspace-level approval.
title: AGENTS.md crate-level dependency restriction list is stale
